text: {"entries":[{"name_han":"...","logic_thesis":"...","logic_chain":"...","logic_practice":"...","logic_compare":"..."}]}{"entries":[{"name_han":"道德真经指归","logic_thesis":"The text proves that cosmic order and personal integrity arise only when naming, desire, and deliberate action are reversed back into emptiness; Dao is not a doctrine to be added but the residual state after all dualistic constructs collapse. Yan Zun’s “pointing-return” method shows that every positive claim about Dao is self-canceling unless it leads the mind to rest in pre-conceptual unity. Therefore political, moral, and bodily order are functions of non-forcing, not of technique piled upon technique.","logic_chain":"1) Premises: all articulation (名) and grasping (欲) split the undivided Dao into usable/unusable pairs. 2) Inference: governance and self-cultivation that multiply norms increase fragmentation. 3) Inference: only “return” (归) to the mother—quiet, low, formless—reassembles potency. 4) Inference: non-action is not passivity but refusal to reify intermediate causes. 5) Conclusion: longevity, social peace, and sagely insight are by-products of returning, not goals pursued as objects.","logic_practice":"1) In BaZi, treat strong Officer/Kill or Output as “naming force”; prescribe rest, stillness, and resource (印) rather than more control. 2) Map Day Master exhaustion to over-articulation; restore via void-water / resource structures that quiet speech and ambition. 3) Daily: reverse one deliberate plan into observation-only for one shichen. 4) Cultivation: breath and mind sink to the “mother” (lower field) whenever naming arises. 5) Reading chart luck: favor cycles that return to root (resource, peer harmony) over expansion peaks.","logic_compare":"Unlike pure Laozi text or Wang Bi’s ontological void, 指归 builds a full Han cosmological ladder (qi, politics, body) from the single move of “return.” It differs from later Chongxuan double-negation by staying affirmative about soft potency rather than dialectical erasure. It is less ritual than Lingbao and less physiological than neidan, yet supplies their shared premise: order follows emptiness."},{"name_han":"老子铭","logic_thesis":"The stele argument proves that the historical Laozi and the cosmic Dao-body are one continuous subject: virtue realized in a human life is the same principle that structures heaven and earth. By inscribing biography into liturgy, it legitimates worship of Laozi as both ancestor-sage and celestial emperor without contradiction. Sanctity is therefore not escape from history but history read as Dao’s self-revelation.","logic_chain":"1) Premise: a named person (Laozi) manifested supreme virtue. 2) Inference: supreme virtue cannot be merely local; it must participate in the generative Dao. 3) Inference: the person is therefore a mode of Dao’s presence (神化). 4) Inference: commemorating him aligns community with that presence. 5) Conclusion: cult, ethics, and cosmology cohere in one figure—duality of “man vs god” is false.","logic_practice":"1) BaZi: when Day Master sits with strong resource/officer, read “sage-potential” as duty to embody principle, not mere status. 2) Use 甲/庚 or 己土 patterns as “inscription” of law into life—discipline as worship. 3) Cultivation: daily reverence to a single Daoist image as continuity of lineage-mind. 4) Moral audit: act as if biography will be read as cosmic evidence. 5) Luck cycles: honor periods of visibility (官印) as tests of whether virtue matches role.","logic_compare":"Unlike 道德真经指归’s abstract return, 老子铭 concretizes Dao in a person and stele cult. Unlike later hagiographies that multiply miracles, it still argues philosophically that man and Dao are non-dual. It is public-political where neidan texts are private-physiological."},{"name_han":"太上玄门早晚功课经","logic_thesis":"The text proves that realization requires rhythmic synchronization of human attention with celestial time: morning and evening liturgy are not accessories but the operational clock of the Daoist body-community. Without fixed dual nodes of recitation, internal cultivation drifts into subjectivity and loses covenant with the Three Realms. Practice is therefore a twice-daily reconstitution of identity as a subject of Heaven.","logic_chain":"1) Premise: spirits, stars, and ancestors operate on calendrical order. 2) Inference: the human heart must meet that order at stable gates (dawn/dusk). 3) Inference: scripture sound and bowing re-pattern qi and intention. 4) Inference: communal cadence prevents solitary delusion. 5) Conclusion: kungke is the minimal lawful interface between free will and cosmic bureaucracy.","logic_practice":"1) BaZi: schedule critical rituals and decisions at chart-aligned shichen (日主旺/生), not arbitrary times. 2) Build personal “morning seal / evening audit” of speech and emotion. 3) Treat 子午 as mandatory still points regardless of busyness. 4) Map luck pillars to when liturgy intensity should increase (clash/punishment years). 5) Use recitation to stabilize weak Day Master or scattered output.","logic_compare":"Unlike pure philosophy (指归) or pure elixir manuals, 功课经 makes time-discipline the proof of orthodoxy. It differs from one-off jiao rites by insisting on daily micro-covenant. Compared with 全真清规, it is sonic-liturgical rather than rule-legal."},{"name_han":"道德真经义疏","logic_thesis":"Through Chongxuan-style layered negation, the commentary proves that both “being” and “non-being,” attachment and anti-attachment, must be emptied before Dao is approached; any fixed metaphysical residual is still a barrier. Meaning (义) is not content piled on Laozi but successive removal of interpretive grasp. True understanding is the mind’s inability to lodge in either affirmation or denial.","logic_chain":"1) Premise: ordinary reading reifies Dao as an object. 2) Inference: first negate worldly being; residual is empty non-being. 3) Inference: non-being itself becomes a new attachment—negate it. 4) Inference: double mystery leaves neither pole. 5) Conclusion: sagely function arises spontaneously from non-lodging, not from a higher concept.","logic_practice":"1) BaZi counseling: refuse single-factor fatalism; negate both “lucky” and “doomed” readings, then act from residual clarity. 2) When chart shows extremes (劫比 vs 伤尽), teach middle path without inventing a third reified force. 3) Meditation: each insight is dropped; no collection of attainments. 4) Speech: stop using Dao terms as identity badges. 5) Luck analysis: interpret clashes as invitations to release both control and resignation.","logic_compare":"Unlike 指归’s soft affirmative return, 义疏 is dialectical and more Buddhist-inflected. Unlike neidan’s staged building of elixir, it stages demolition of views. It is scholastic where 老子铭 is cultic."},{"name_han":"太上说南斗六司延寿度人妙经","logic_thesis":"The scripture proves that lifespan and salvation are administratively mediated: Southern Dipper officers hold dossiers of life-span, so extension of years is not raw biology but lawful petition within stellar bureaucracy. Destiny is editable at the margin when ritual sincerity aligns with office and virtue. Human effort without celestial registry is incomplete; registry without virtue is deaf.","logic_chain":"1) Premise: six Southern Dipper offices govern fate, death, and blessing. 2) Inference: life-span is a file, not a fixed atom. 3) Inference: correct rite, repentance, and merit request amendment. 4) Inference: “degree-person” (度人) is transfer of status in the otherworldly census. 5) Conclusion: longevity practice must couple ethics with petition, not breath alone.","logic_practice":"1) BaZi: weak 印/食伤 to 官 can signal “thin registry”; strengthen resource and virtue acts. 2) In 辰戌丑未 or star-related years, schedule longevity rites and charity. 3) Read 七杀 without root as short-fuse destiny needing Southern Dipper-style restraint and merit. 4) Combine medical yangsheng with confession of faults. 5) Track birth hour accuracy—hour is the “file stamp” of life administration.","logic_compare":"Unlike pure neidan (大丹直指) that interiorizes stars as body gods, this text keeps external stellar offices real. Unlike moral tracts alone, it supplies a concrete celestial court. It is more bureaucratic than Shangqing free flight of the spirit."},{"name_han":"太清玉碑子","logic_thesis":"Cast as jade-tablet transmission, the text proves that authentic alchemical order is concise, inscribed, and non-proliferating: true method fits a “stele” of essentials rather than endless artifice. Taiqing tradition hereby argues that lead-mercury / fire-timing truths are few and must be held as fixed law. Complexity without tablet-authority is counterfeit.","logic_chain":"1) Premise: Daoist method degenerates when oral noise multiplies. 2) Inference: legit teaching is compressed into stele-like axioms. 3) Inference: body and furnace obey the same few dualities (yin-yang, water-fire). 4) Inference: practitioner tests claims against the tablet, not fashion. 5) Conclusion: orthodoxy = brevity under authority.","logic_practice":"1) BaZi: reduce multi-factor panic to a short “tablet”: DM, useful god, timing, taboo. 2) Neidan: keep only fire phase, medicine, and vessel rules—drop ornamental techniques. 3) Write personal three-line cultivation oath and review weekly. 4) Reject teachers who cannot state method in few propositions. 5) Luck: one seasonal rule beats ten simultaneous remedies.","logic_compare":"Unlike encyclopedic 上清灵宝大法, 玉碑子 prizes minimal inscription. Unlike 金丹大要’s expansive synthesis, it is aphoristic. It shares Taiqing metallurgical ancestry rather than Quanzhen monastic ethics."},{"name_han":"太清真人络命诀","logic_thesis":"The text proves that “life” (命) is a networked qi-circuit (络): destiny is not only natal chart abstractly but the patency of channels that circulate prenatal vitality. To “connect life” is to restore linkage between cosmic qi and bodily collaterals; broken network equals truncated fate. Cultivation is therefore network engineering of breath and spirit through pathways.","logic_chain":"1) Premise: life depends on continuous qi linkage. 2) Inference: collaterals are the map of that linkage. 3) Inference: blockage or leakage shortens or disorders fate. 4) Inference: true person methods re-open and re-seal the network. 5) Conclusion: destiny work must be somatic-channel work, not wish alone.","logic_practice":"1) BaZi: when 食伤 drains or 官杀 over-controls, treat as channel leakage/constraint; prescribe rest and resource. 2) Pair chart reading with pulse/breath observation. 3) Daily: embryonic-adjacent breathing to “rewire” lung-kidney axis. 4) In clash years of health palace, prioritize meridian-smoothing over ambition. 5) Use massage/stillness at key junctions before major decisions.","logic_compare":"Unlike 南斗经’s external bureaucracy, 络命诀 interiorizes fate into channels. Unlike purely mental 心印经, it is anatomical. It bridges medicine and Dao more tightly than abstract Laozi commentaries."},{"name_han":"太微灵书紫文琅玕华丹神真上经","logic_thesis":"Shangqing purple-text logic proves that the highest elixir is a celestial script internalized: by visualizing and embodying Taiwei’s jade-gem (琅玕) floriate elixir, the adept grows a body continuous with stellar script. Salvation is not moral petition alone but ontological upgrade via received luminous text. The scripture is both map and medicine.","logic_chain":"1) Premise: heaven stores true form as purple writ. 2) Inference: human decline is amnesia of that form. 3) Inference: recitation-visualization re-inscribes the form in the viscera. 4) Inference: gem-elixir imagery crystallizes qi into immortal structure. 5) Conclusion: reading is transformation when done as theophany, not information.","logic_practice":"1) BaZi: strong 印 with clear 食伤 can indicate “script capacity”—favor study/visualization paths. 2) Night practice facing corresponding stellar sector when luck supports fire/wood ascent. 3) Treat scriptures as active agents: slow chant > silent skim. 4) Build “inner text” of few images (sun-moon, purple qi) tied to breath. 5) Avoid crude chemical waidan; keep floriate elixir symbolic-somatic.","logic_compare":"Unlike Taiqing lab-leaning texts, this is visionary Shangqing. Unlike 功课经’s communal cadence, it is aristocratic solitary ascent. Unlike 大丹直指’s plain speech, it is ornate celestial code."},{"name_han":"太上养生胎息气经","logic_thesis":"The text proves that post-natal breathing is a fall from the embryo’s sealed circulation; restoration of embryonic breath (胎息) re-enters the pre-birth economy of qi and thereby lengthens life. Yangsheng is regression in the precise sense: less external respiration, more internal recycling of spirit-qi. Longevity is return to the gestational algorithm.","logic_chain":"1) Premise: fetus lives without mouth-breath, whole via umbilical-cosmic qi. 2) Inference: birth opens leakage through ordinary breath and desire. 3) Inference: training softens, lengthens, and internalizes breath until “breathing without breathing.” 4) Inference: spirit settles, essence seals. 5) Conclusion: health and immortality techniques share one root—re-embryogenesis of qi.","logic_practice":"1) BaZi: weak water/resource or damaged 印 → prioritize breath sealing over aggressive career fire. 2) Practice closed-mouth soft breathing in 丑寅 hours. 3) Link chart “prenatal” (year) to “postnatal” (hour) with breath as bridge. 4) Sexual/output restraint as non-leakage companion to胎息. 5) In illness luck, choose breath medicine before stimulant remedies.","logic_compare":"Unlike stellar petition (南斗),胎息 is wholly physiological-mystical. Unlike purple-text floriate visualization, it is almost method-minimal. It is closer to 络命诀 than to moral 觉世真经."},{"name_han":"太上洞玄灵宝开演秘密藏经","logic_thesis":"Lingbao logic here proves that the cosmos contains a “secret treasury” (秘密藏) of salvific structure already complete; revelation is unlocking, not inventing. Preaching (开演) opens what was sealed so that beings can access the hidden store of Dao. Hierarchy of scriptures and rites is a keyring to that treasury, not arbitrary church power.","logic_chain":"1) Premise: Dao’s full method is stored, not absent. 2) Inference: beings suffer from sealed access, not from empty cosmos. 3) Inference: authentic scripture performs unlocking. 4) Inference: ritual grades match treasury layers. 5) Conclusion: study and rite are progressive unsealing of one store.","logic_practice":"1) BaZi: read buried useful gods (合住/库) as “sealed treasury”—timing that opens the vault. 2) Prefer staged learning: ethics → breath → rite → vision. 3) In 库地 years (辰戌丑未), practice “opening” via confession and study. 4) Don’t scatter across schools; deepen one key. 5) Teaching: reveal only what student vessel can hold—treasury discipline.","logic_compare":"Unlike Laozi’s anti-archival simplicity, Lingbao affirms sacred archive. Unlike Quanzhen “heart seal” minimalism, it is cosmological-revealed abundance. Differs from 上清紫文 by emphasizing universal degree-person salvation over elite immortal bureaucracy."},{"name_han":"上清后圣道君列纪","logic_thesis":"The chronicle proves history is soteriological: the Latter Saint Dao-Lord’s career and calendar structure a future collective rescue, so personal cultivation plugs into messianic time. Genealogy of saints is not trivia but a timeline of when heaven’s intervention becomes available. Hope is chronological and hierarchical under Shangqing eschatology.","logic_chain":"1) Premise: a future perfected Lord coordinates salvation. 2) Inference: ages have quality; not all times equally open. 3) Inference: adepts align practice with prophesied sequence. 4) Inference: receiving registers ties personal fate to that sequence. 5) Conclusion: biography of the saint is a map of cosmic emergency response.","logic_practice":"1) BaZi: major luck shifts as “age quality” changes—plan vows and retreats at pillar turns. 2) Lineage dates and ritual calendars as non-optional. 3) Cultivate readiness (virtue + stability) rather than date-speculation panic. 4) Use officer/resource years for ordination-like commitments. 5) Community: prefer ordered transmission over DIY apocalypse anxiety.","logic_compare":"Unlike daily 功课经, this is macro-historical. Unlike 金丹大要’s internal cycle only, it keeps external sacred history. More Shangqing-eschatological than Quanzhen’s present-tense mind-nature focus."},{"name_han":"上阳子金丹大要","logic_thesis":"Chen Zhixu proves that all alchemical metaphors (kan-li, lead-mercury, dragon-tiger) collapse into one law: dual cultivation of nature and life through correctly timed reunion of true yin and true yang in the body-mind. The “great essentials” are not many secrets but one homology restated—cosmology, sex of symbols, and meditation are the same diagram. Without pre-heaven true seed and post-heaven fire timing, talk of gold elixir is literature.","logic_chain":"1) Premise: classics use many images for one process. 2) Inference: confusion comes from taking images as separate recipes. 3) Inference: locate true yin/yang (kan’s solid, li’s broken) in one’s own system. 4) Inference: gather, cook, and transmute by order: essence → qi → spirit → void. 5) Conclusion: orthodoxy = unity of xing-ming under that order; heresy = partial or inverted sequence.","logic_practice":"1) BaZi: map 水火 as kan-li; when water/fire imbalance, prescribe lifestyle as “firing.” 2) Day Master + spouse as medicine vs fire; spouse palace as partner-symbol, not necessarily literal dual practice. 3) Stages: stabilize essence years before aggressive “fire.” 4) Study one image set until homologous with breath-mind. 5) Luck: use resource periods for “medicine,” output for “firing,” avoid full fire in essence-deficient charts.","logic_compare":"More synthetic and polemical than 大丹直指’s plain diagrams; more dual-cultivation explicit than many Quanzhen public texts. Less liturgical than Lingbao dafa; more scholastic than 九要心印’s brevity."},{"name_han":"大丹直指","logic_thesis":"Attributed to Qiu Chuji’s lineage, the text proves that the golden elixir secret is exhausted by xing and ming: nature latent at the crown, life latent in the navel-kidney system, and their reunion via three treasures refining. Direct pointing means no ornamental cosmology is needed—figures of dragon-tiger, microcosmic orbit, and five-qi chaoyuan are operational steps. Immortality is engineered sequence, not mystical mood.","logic_chain":"1) Premise: xing is heavenly, ming earthly; both constitute the person. 2) Inference: exclusive nature-work or exclusive life-work fails. 3) Inference: refine essence to qi, qi to spirit, spirit to Dao. 4) Inference: diagrams encode timing and location of fire. 5) Conclusion: success criteria are somatic-spiritual events (return of light, five qi to origin), not belief.","logic_practice":"1) BaZi: diagnose which of xing/ming is deficient (印 vs 日主/库根). 2) Sequence training with luck: essence sealing in weak years, orbit when stable. 3) Use 子午周天 aligned with chart’s peak water-fire. 4) Track sleep, sexual loss, anger as three-treasure leaks. 5) Prefer plain method logs over visionary inflation.","logic_compare":"Straighter and more Quanzhen-operational than 上阳子’s dense classic-weaving. Less moral-public than 清规; less stellar-bureaucratic than 南斗经. Companion to 九要心印 but fuller in stepwise diagrams."},{"name_han":"全真清规","logic_thesis":"The pure regulations prove that communal law is a spiritual technology: without precept, schedule, and hierarchical correction, “complete reality” talk collapses into egoic freedom. Monastery rules are not obstacles to Dao but the exoskeleton that keeps xing-ming work possible. Liberation is downstream of obedience to a shared form.","logic_chain":"1) Premise: human habit scatters qi and intent. 2) Inference: external clear rules reduce decision noise. 3) Inference: community witness exposes self-deception. 4) Inference: graded penalties re-align conduct with vow. 5) Conclusion: Qinggui is first gate of Quanzhen attainment.","logic_practice":"1) BaZi clients with strong 伤官/劫财: design personal qinggui (sleep, speech, spending). 2) Map 官杀 as useful “regulation gods,” not only oppression. 3) Weekly self-court: confess breaches; small penalties. 4) Group practice > lone heroics for unstable charts. 5) In 官印 luck, institutionalize habits permanently.","logic_compare":"Unlike 功课经 which scripts liturgy, 清规 scripts behavior law. Unlike solitary Shangqing ascent, it is coenobitic. More ethical-legal than 胎息’s breath focus, yet serves the same non-leakage goal."},{"name_han":"道门通教必用集","logic_thesis":"The collection proves that “universal teaching” needs a portable toolkit: forms, documents, and rites that any orthodox cleric must command for the religion to function across regions. Utility (必用) is itself doctrinal—Daoism without shared procedural literacy cannot save or govern spirits. Standardization is compassion at scale.","logic_chain":"1) Premise: Daoist work includes petition, burial, jiao, and counsel. 2) Inference: each act requires correct form to be recognized by spirits and society. 3) Inference: anthologizing essentials prevents local corruption of method. 4) Inference: cleric identity = mastery of necessary set. 5) Conclusion: orthopraxy package defines membership more than private gnosis.","logic_practice":"1) BaZi professional ethics: standard intake, disclaimer, and follow-up templates as “必用.” 2) Learn minimal rite set for life events tied to chart crises. 3) Prefer correct form over improvised theatrics. 4) Cross-check local custom against classic procedure. 5) Train speech that is formulary yet sincere.","logic_compare":"Practical handbook vs speculative 义疏; clerical vs lay moral 觉世真经. Narrower than 上清灵宝大法’s ocean of methods—selects what must be used, not all that can."},{"name_han":"上清灵宝大法","logic_thesis":"The great method proves that Shangqing vision and Lingbao universal salvation can be engineered as one ritual system: cosmology, registers, thunder/writing, and degree-person rites interlock so that private immortality and public salvation share machinery. Completeness of method is the argument—partial lineages are incomplete medicine for a multi-layered cosmos.","logic_chain":"1) Premise: world includes heavens, hells, stars, ancestors, and living bodies. 2) Inference: one technique class cannot address all layers. 3) Inference: integrated dafa assigns tools to layers. 4) Inference: master of dafa becomes cosmic functionary. 5) Conclusion: vastness is necessary, not decadent, for full soteriology.","logic_practice":"1) BaZi: multi-palace problems need multi-tools (ethics + breath + rite + environment). 2) Don’t treat career clash like health clash. 3) Build personal “small dafa”: ranked responses by severity. 4) Study symbolism of registers as chart “files.” 5) Avoid method hoarding without virtue base.","logic_compare":"Maximalist versus 玉碑子 minimalism and 九要心印 condensation. More ritual-technical than 金丹大要’s interior alchemy. Synthesizes what 开演秘密藏经 theorizes as treasury."},{"name_han":"太上说十炼生神救护经","logic_thesis":"The text proves that spirit-body gods are produced or restored through ten stages of refinement; rescue (救护) is metallurgy of the person. Salvation is not a single pardon but iterative tempering until protective deities within are viable. Disaster and early death signal incomplete refining of the spirit set.","logic_chain":"1) Premise: person hosts multiple spirits needing generation/completion. 2) Inference: stages of refining correspond to layers of vulnerability. 3) Inference: each completed stage adds protection and clarity. 4) Inference: rite and ascesis enact the tenfold sequence. 5) Conclusion: rescue = completed internal pantheon via disciplined process.","logic_practice":"1) BaZi: count repeated damage to same element as failed “refine stage”—design ten-step remediation. 2) Pair decade luck with stage goals (essence, qi, spirit…). 3) After acute danger years, perform rebuilding regimen, not only relief. 4) Visualize organ-spirits in medical-Daoist hygiene. 5) Ethical refining (truthfulness, non-harm) as co-equal to breath stages.","logic_compare":"More sequential-soteriological than 胎息’s single method; more internalized than 南斗 external officers—yet compatible (inner gods ↔ outer offices). Differs from 清规 by focusing on spirit-generation rather than monastic law."},{"name_han":"关圣帝君觉世真经","logic_thesis":"The scripture proves that cosmic justice is transparent and responsive: moral acts write directly into fortune, and “awakening the world” is exposing that ledger so people self-correct. Guandi as enforcer unites martial uprightness with retributive clarity—no esotericism excuses vice. Public ethics are the accessible face of Dao for ordinary destiny repair.","logic_chain":"1) Premise: heaven’s eye and spirit officers record deeds. 2) Inference: good/bad issue in measurable life outcomes. 3) Inference: preaching the ledger awakens fear and resolve. 4) Inference: repentance plus reform rewrites pending retribution. 5) Conclusion: social morality is practical theology of fate.","logic_practice":"1) BaZi: when 七杀/羊刃 without virtue narrative, prescribe Guandi-style precepts first. 2) Audit speech, money, sex as three high-retribution channels. 3) Use oath and public accountability for 伤官 charts. 4) Charity timed to conflict years as counter-ledger. 5) Read sudden disasters as prompts to moral review, not only luck mechanics.","logic_compare":"Exoteric vs neidan secrecy; Chinese theistic retribution vs Laozi’s amoral cosmism. Complements 南斗 petition with ethical precondition. Less clerical-technical than 道门通教必用集; aimed at lay transformation."},{"name_han":"太上无极大道自然真一五称符上经","logic_thesis":"The text proves that the “True One” of spontaneous Dao expresses as five appellation-talismans: cosmic functions are nameable seals that, when correctly held, reunify multiplicity into natural unity. Symbol and reality are not two—the fu is the operable face of Wuji’s true one. Practice is alignment with fivefold self-naming of the Dao rather than personal invention.","logic_chain":"1) Premise: Ultimate Non-Polar still issues patterned functions. 2) Inference: five titles/fu encode those functions. 3) Inference: holding/inscribing them tunes agent to natural True One. 4) Inference: disorder is misalignment with the fivefold seal. 5) Conclusion: talismanic practice is metaphysics made portable.","logic_practice":"1) BaZi: five phases as five “appellations” of one Day Master life—restore missing phase as restoring a seal. 2) Draw or visualize phase-correct symbols in corresponding seasons. 3) Speech: five true names of intent (stillness, clarity, fairness, restraint, sincerity). 4) Correct environment colors/directions as fu-fields. 5) Avoid random talisman collecting; match to chart deficit.","logic_compare":"More abstract-cosmological than 关帝 moralism; more symbolic-operational than pure 指归 philosophy. Shares Lingbao love of writs but centers True One fivefold structure rather than full dafa bureaucracy."},{"name_han":"太上九要心印妙经","logic_thesis":"The scripture proves that the entire elixir path compresses into nine essentials sealed in the heart-mind: transmission is mind-to-mind imprint (心印), not accumulation of texts. If the seal is true, few words suffice; if false, oceans of classics fail. Mastery is verified by interior certification, not external display.","logic_chain":"1) Premise: Dao’s method is simple at root. 2) Inference: proliferation hides the seal. 3) Inference: nine essentials structure the whole path. 4) Inference: heart receives imprint when vessel is still and ethical. 5) Conclusion: authentic lineage is recognition of the same seal, expressed as brief keys.","logic_practice":"1) BaZi: extract nine maxims max from any chart—no encyclopedic dump. 2) Meditation: one mudra of intent (true seal) each session. 3) Test teachings: can they restate 金丹大要/大丹直指 in nine points without remainder? 4) In confused luck, return to essentials list. 5) Teacher choice: who impresses seal, not who performs complexity.","logic_compare":"Most compressed counterweight to 上清灵宝大法 and even 金丹大要. Aligns with 大丹直指’s “direct pointing” but framed as heart-seal mysticism. Differs from 功课经 by being non-liturgical interior certification."}]}

entries.logic_practice: 1) In BaZi, treat strong Officer/Kill or Output as “naming force”; prescribe rest, stillness, and resource (印) rather than more control. 2) Map Day Master exhaustion to over-articulation; restore via void-water / resource structures that quiet speech and ambition. 3) Daily: reverse one deliberate plan into observation-only for one shichen. 4) Cultivation: breath and mind sink to the “mother” (lower field) whenever naming arises. 5) Reading chart luck: favor cycles that return to root (resource, peer harmony) over expansion peaks.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike pure Laozi text or Wang Bi’s ontological void, 指归 builds a full Han cosmological ladder (qi, politics, body) from the single move of “return.” It differs from later Chongxuan double-negation by staying affirmative about soft potency rather than dialectical erasure. It is less ritual than Lingbao and less physiological than neidan, yet supplies their shared premise: order follows emptiness.

entries.logic_thesis: The stele argument proves that the historical Laozi and the cosmic Dao-body are one continuous subject: virtue realized in a human life is the same principle that structures heaven and earth. By inscribing biography into liturgy, it legitimates worship of Laozi as both ancestor-sage and celestial emperor without contradiction. Sanctity is therefore not escape from history but history read as Dao’s self-revelation.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: a named person (Laozi) manifested supreme virtue. 2) Inference: supreme virtue cannot be merely local; it must participate in the generative Dao. 3) Inference: the person is therefore a mode of Dao’s presence (神化). 4) Inference: commemorating him aligns community with that presence. 5) Conclusion: cult, ethics, and cosmology cohere in one figure—duality of “man vs god” is false.
entries.logic_practice: 1) BaZi: when Day Master sits with strong resource/officer, read “sage-potential” as duty to embody principle, not mere status. 2) Use 甲/庚 or 己土 patterns as “inscription” of law into life—discipline as worship. 3) Cultivation: daily reverence to a single Daoist image as continuity of lineage-mind. 4) Moral audit: act as if biography will be read as cosmic evidence. 5) Luck cycles: honor periods of visibility (官印) as tests of whether virtue matches role.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 道德真经指归’s abstract return, 老子铭 concretizes Dao in a person and stele cult. Unlike later hagiographies that multiply miracles, it still argues philosophically that man and Dao are non-dual. It is public-political where neidan texts are private-physiological.

entries.logic_thesis: The text proves that realization requires rhythmic synchronization of human attention with celestial time: morning and evening liturgy are not accessories but the operational clock of the Daoist body-community. Without fixed dual nodes of recitation, internal cultivation drifts into subjectivity and loses covenant with the Three Realms. Practice is therefore a twice-daily reconstitution of identity as a subject of Heaven.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: spirits, stars, and ancestors operate on calendrical order. 2) Inference: the human heart must meet that order at stable gates (dawn/dusk). 3) Inference: scripture sound and bowing re-pattern qi and intention. 4) Inference: communal cadence prevents solitary delusion. 5) Conclusion: kungke is the minimal lawful interface between free will and cosmic bureaucracy.
entries.logic_practice: 1) BaZi: schedule critical rituals and decisions at chart-aligned shichen (日主旺/生), not arbitrary times. 2) Build personal “morning seal / evening audit” of speech and emotion. 3) Treat 子午 as mandatory still points regardless of busyness. 4) Map luck pillars to when liturgy intensity should increase (clash/punishment years). 5) Use recitation to stabilize weak Day Master or scattered output.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike pure philosophy (指归) or pure elixir manuals, 功课经 makes time-discipline the proof of orthodoxy. It differs from one-off jiao rites by insisting on daily micro-covenant. Compared with 全真清规, it is sonic-liturgical rather than rule-legal.

entries.logic_thesis: Through Chongxuan-style layered negation, the commentary proves that both “being” and “non-being,” attachment and anti-attachment, must be emptied before Dao is approached; any fixed metaphysical residual is still a barrier. Meaning (义) is not content piled on Laozi but successive removal of interpretive grasp. True understanding is the mind’s inability to lodge in either affirmation or denial.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: ordinary reading reifies Dao as an object. 2) Inference: first negate worldly being; residual is empty non-being. 3) Inference: non-being itself becomes a new attachment—negate it. 4) Inference: double mystery leaves neither pole. 5) Conclusion: sagely function arises spontaneously from non-lodging, not from a higher concept.
entries.logic_practice: 1) BaZi counseling: refuse single-factor fatalism; negate both “lucky” and “doomed” readings, then act from residual clarity. 2) When chart shows extremes (劫比 vs 伤尽), teach middle path without inventing a third reified force. 3) Meditation: each insight is dropped; no collection of attainments. 4) Speech: stop using Dao terms as identity badges. 5) Luck analysis: interpret clashes as invitations to release both control and resignation.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 指归’s soft affirmative return, 义疏 is dialectical and more Buddhist-inflected. Unlike neidan’s staged building of elixir, it stages demolition of views. It is scholastic where 老子铭 is cultic.

entries.name_han: 太上说南斗六司延寿度人妙经
entries.logic_thesis: The scripture proves that lifespan and salvation are administratively mediated: Southern Dipper officers hold dossiers of life-span, so extension of years is not raw biology but lawful petition within stellar bureaucracy. Destiny is editable at the margin when ritual sincerity aligns with office and virtue. Human effort without celestial registry is incomplete; registry without virtue is deaf.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: six Southern Dipper offices govern fate, death, and blessing. 2) Inference: life-span is a file, not a fixed atom. 3) Inference: correct rite, repentance, and merit request amendment. 4) Inference: “degree-person” (度人) is transfer of status in the otherworldly census. 5) Conclusion: longevity practice must couple ethics with petition, not breath alone.
entries.logic_practice: 1) BaZi: weak 印/食伤 to 官 can signal “thin registry”; strengthen resource and virtue acts. 2) In 辰戌丑未 or star-related years, schedule longevity rites and charity. 3) Read 七杀 without root as short-fuse destiny needing Southern Dipper-style restraint and merit. 4) Combine medical yangsheng with confession of faults. 5) Track birth hour accuracy—hour is the “file stamp” of life administration.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike pure neidan (大丹直指) that interiorizes stars as body gods, this text keeps external stellar offices real. Unlike moral tracts alone, it supplies a concrete celestial court. It is more bureaucratic than Shangqing free flight of the spirit.

entries.logic_thesis: Cast as jade-tablet transmission, the text proves that authentic alchemical order is concise, inscribed, and non-proliferating: true method fits a “stele” of essentials rather than endless artifice. Taiqing tradition hereby argues that lead-mercury / fire-timing truths are few and must be held as fixed law. Complexity without tablet-authority is counterfeit.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: Daoist method degenerates when oral noise multiplies. 2) Inference: legit teaching is compressed into stele-like axioms. 3) Inference: body and furnace obey the same few dualities (yin-yang, water-fire). 4) Inference: practitioner tests claims against the tablet, not fashion. 5) Conclusion: orthodoxy = brevity under authority.
entries.logic_practice: 1) BaZi: reduce multi-factor panic to a short “tablet”: DM, useful god, timing, taboo. 2) Neidan: keep only fire phase, medicine, and vessel rules—drop ornamental techniques. 3) Write personal three-line cultivation oath and review weekly. 4) Reject teachers who cannot state method in few propositions. 5) Luck: one seasonal rule beats ten simultaneous remedies.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike encyclopedic 上清灵宝大法, 玉碑子 prizes minimal inscription. Unlike 金丹大要’s expansive synthesis, it is aphoristic. It shares Taiqing metallurgical ancestry rather than Quanzhen monastic ethics.

entries.logic_thesis: The text proves that “life” (命) is a networked qi-circuit (络): destiny is not only natal chart abstractly but the patency of channels that circulate prenatal vitality. To “connect life” is to restore linkage between cosmic qi and bodily collaterals; broken network equals truncated fate. Cultivation is therefore network engineering of breath and spirit through pathways.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: life depends on continuous qi linkage. 2) Inference: collaterals are the map of that linkage. 3) Inference: blockage or leakage shortens or disorders fate. 4) Inference: true person methods re-open and re-seal the network. 5) Conclusion: destiny work must be somatic-channel work, not wish alone.
entries.logic_practice: 1) BaZi: when 食伤 drains or 官杀 over-controls, treat as channel leakage/constraint; prescribe rest and resource. 2) Pair chart reading with pulse/breath observation. 3) Daily: embryonic-adjacent breathing to “rewire” lung-kidney axis. 4) In clash years of health palace, prioritize meridian-smoothing over ambition. 5) Use massage/stillness at key junctions before major decisions.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 南斗经’s external bureaucracy, 络命诀 interiorizes fate into channels. Unlike purely mental 心印经, it is anatomical. It bridges medicine and Dao more tightly than abstract Laozi commentaries.

entries.name_han: 太微灵书紫文琅玕华丹神真上经
entries.logic_thesis: Shangqing purple-text logic proves that the highest elixir is a celestial script internalized: by visualizing and embodying Taiwei’s jade-gem (琅玕) floriate elixir, the adept grows a body continuous with stellar script. Salvation is not moral petition alone but ontological upgrade via received luminous text. The scripture is both map and medicine.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: heaven stores true form as purple writ. 2) Inference: human decline is amnesia of that form. 3) Inference: recitation-visualization re-inscribes the form in the viscera. 4) Inference: gem-elixir imagery crystallizes qi into immortal structure. 5) Conclusion: reading is transformation when done as theophany, not information.
entries.logic_practice: 1) BaZi: strong 印 with clear 食伤 can indicate “script capacity”—favor study/visualization paths. 2) Night practice facing corresponding stellar sector when luck supports fire/wood ascent. 3) Treat scriptures as active agents: slow chant > silent skim. 4) Build “inner text” of few images (sun-moon, purple qi) tied to breath. 5) Avoid crude chemical waidan; keep floriate elixir symbolic-somatic.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike Taiqing lab-leaning texts, this is visionary Shangqing. Unlike 功课经’s communal cadence, it is aristocratic solitary ascent. Unlike 大丹直指’s plain speech, it is ornate celestial code.

entries.logic_thesis: The text proves that post-natal breathing is a fall from the embryo’s sealed circulation; restoration of embryonic breath (胎息) re-enters the pre-birth economy of qi and thereby lengthens life. Yangsheng is regression in the precise sense: less external respiration, more internal recycling of spirit-qi. Longevity is return to the gestational algorithm.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: fetus lives without mouth-breath, whole via umbilical-cosmic qi. 2) Inference: birth opens leakage through ordinary breath and desire. 3) Inference: training softens, lengthens, and internalizes breath until “breathing without breathing.” 4) Inference: spirit settles, essence seals. 5) Conclusion: health and immortality techniques share one root—re-embryogenesis of qi.
entries.logic_practice: 1) BaZi: weak water/resource or damaged 印 → prioritize breath sealing over aggressive career fire. 2) Practice closed-mouth soft breathing in 丑寅 hours. 3) Link chart “prenatal” (year) to “postnatal” (hour) with breath as bridge. 4) Sexual/output restraint as non-leakage companion to胎息. 5) In illness luck, choose breath medicine before stimulant remedies.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike stellar petition (南斗),胎息 is wholly physiological-mystical. Unlike purple-text floriate visualization, it is almost method-minimal. It is closer to 络命诀 than to moral 觉世真经.

entries.name_han: 太上洞玄灵宝开演秘密藏经
entries.logic_thesis: Lingbao logic here proves that the cosmos contains a “secret treasury” (秘密藏) of salvific structure already complete; revelation is unlocking, not inventing. Preaching (开演) opens what was sealed so that beings can access the hidden store of Dao. Hierarchy of scriptures and rites is a keyring to that treasury, not arbitrary church power.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: Dao’s full method is stored, not absent. 2) Inference: beings suffer from sealed access, not from empty cosmos. 3) Inference: authentic scripture performs unlocking. 4) Inference: ritual grades match treasury layers. 5) Conclusion: study and rite are progressive unsealing of one store.
entries.logic_practice: 1) BaZi: read buried useful gods (合住/库) as “sealed treasury”—timing that opens the vault. 2) Prefer staged learning: ethics → breath → rite → vision. 3) In 库地 years (辰戌丑未), practice “opening” via confession and study. 4) Don’t scatter across schools; deepen one key. 5) Teaching: reveal only what student vessel can hold—treasury discipline.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike Laozi’s anti-archival simplicity, Lingbao affirms sacred archive. Unlike Quanzhen “heart seal” minimalism, it is cosmological-revealed abundance. Differs from 上清紫文 by emphasizing universal degree-person salvation over elite immortal bureaucracy.

entries.logic_thesis: The chronicle proves history is soteriological: the Latter Saint Dao-Lord’s career and calendar structure a future collective rescue, so personal cultivation plugs into messianic time. Genealogy of saints is not trivia but a timeline of when heaven’s intervention becomes available. Hope is chronological and hierarchical under Shangqing eschatology.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: a future perfected Lord coordinates salvation. 2) Inference: ages have quality; not all times equally open. 3) Inference: adepts align practice with prophesied sequence. 4) Inference: receiving registers ties personal fate to that sequence. 5) Conclusion: biography of the saint is a map of cosmic emergency response.
entries.logic_practice: 1) BaZi: major luck shifts as “age quality” changes—plan vows and retreats at pillar turns. 2) Lineage dates and ritual calendars as non-optional. 3) Cultivate readiness (virtue + stability) rather than date-speculation panic. 4) Use officer/resource years for ordination-like commitments. 5) Community: prefer ordered transmission over DIY apocalypse anxiety.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike daily 功课经, this is macro-historical. Unlike 金丹大要’s internal cycle only, it keeps external sacred history. More Shangqing-eschatological than Quanzhen’s present-tense mind-nature focus.

entries.logic_thesis: Chen Zhixu proves that all alchemical metaphors (kan-li, lead-mercury, dragon-tiger) collapse into one law: dual cultivation of nature and life through correctly timed reunion of true yin and true yang in the body-mind. The “great essentials” are not many secrets but one homology restated—cosmology, sex of symbols, and meditation are the same diagram. Without pre-heaven true seed and post-heaven fire timing, talk of gold elixir is literature.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: classics use many images for one process. 2) Inference: confusion comes from taking images as separate recipes. 3) Inference: locate true yin/yang (kan’s solid, li’s broken) in one’s own system. 4) Inference: gather, cook, and transmute by order: essence → qi → spirit → void. 5) Conclusion: orthodoxy = unity of xing-ming under that order; heresy = partial or inverted sequence.
entries.logic_practice: 1) BaZi: map 水火 as kan-li; when water/fire imbalance, prescribe lifestyle as “firing.” 2) Day Master + spouse as medicine vs fire; spouse palace as partner-symbol, not necessarily literal dual practice. 3) Stages: stabilize essence years before aggressive “fire.” 4) Study one image set until homologous with breath-mind. 5) Luck: use resource periods for “medicine,” output for “firing,” avoid full fire in essence-deficient charts.
entries.logic_compare: More synthetic and polemical than 大丹直指’s plain diagrams; more dual-cultivation explicit than many Quanzhen public texts. Less liturgical than Lingbao dafa; more scholastic than 九要心印’s brevity.

entries.logic_thesis: Attributed to Qiu Chuji’s lineage, the text proves that the golden elixir secret is exhausted by xing and ming: nature latent at the crown, life latent in the navel-kidney system, and their reunion via three treasures refining. Direct pointing means no ornamental cosmology is needed—figures of dragon-tiger, microcosmic orbit, and five-qi chaoyuan are operational steps. Immortality is engineered sequence, not mystical mood.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: xing is heavenly, ming earthly; both constitute the person. 2) Inference: exclusive nature-work or exclusive life-work fails. 3) Inference: refine essence to qi, qi to spirit, spirit to Dao. 4) Inference: diagrams encode timing and location of fire. 5) Conclusion: success criteria are somatic-spiritual events (return of light, five qi to origin), not belief.
entries.logic_practice: 1) BaZi: diagnose which of xing/ming is deficient (印 vs 日主/库根). 2) Sequence training with luck: essence sealing in weak years, orbit when stable. 3) Use 子午周天 aligned with chart’s peak water-fire. 4) Track sleep, sexual loss, anger as three-treasure leaks. 5) Prefer plain method logs over visionary inflation.
entries.logic_compare: Straighter and more Quanzhen-operational than 上阳子’s dense classic-weaving. Less moral-public than 清规; less stellar-bureaucratic than 南斗经. Companion to 九要心印 but fuller in stepwise diagrams.

entries.logic_thesis: The pure regulations prove that communal law is a spiritual technology: without precept, schedule, and hierarchical correction, “complete reality” talk collapses into egoic freedom. Monastery rules are not obstacles to Dao but the exoskeleton that keeps xing-ming work possible. Liberation is downstream of obedience to a shared form.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: human habit scatters qi and intent. 2) Inference: external clear rules reduce decision noise. 3) Inference: community witness exposes self-deception. 4) Inference: graded penalties re-align conduct with vow. 5) Conclusion: Qinggui is first gate of Quanzhen attainment.
entries.logic_practice: 1) BaZi clients with strong 伤官/劫财: design personal qinggui (sleep, speech, spending). 2) Map 官杀 as useful “regulation gods,” not only oppression. 3) Weekly self-court: confess breaches; small penalties. 4) Group practice > lone heroics for unstable charts. 5) In 官印 luck, institutionalize habits permanently.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 功课经 which scripts liturgy, 清规 scripts behavior law. Unlike solitary Shangqing ascent, it is coenobitic. More ethical-legal than 胎息’s breath focus, yet serves the same non-leakage goal.

entries.logic_thesis: The collection proves that “universal teaching” needs a portable toolkit: forms, documents, and rites that any orthodox cleric must command for the religion to function across regions. Utility (必用) is itself doctrinal—Daoism without shared procedural literacy cannot save or govern spirits. Standardization is compassion at scale.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: Daoist work includes petition, burial, jiao, and counsel. 2) Inference: each act requires correct form to be recognized by spirits and society. 3) Inference: anthologizing essentials prevents local corruption of method. 4) Inference: cleric identity = mastery of necessary set. 5) Conclusion: orthopraxy package defines membership more than private gnosis.
entries.logic_practice: 1) BaZi professional ethics: standard intake, disclaimer, and follow-up templates as “必用.” 2) Learn minimal rite set for life events tied to chart crises. 3) Prefer correct form over improvised theatrics. 4) Cross-check local custom against classic procedure. 5) Train speech that is formulary yet sincere.
entries.logic_compare: Practical handbook vs speculative 义疏; clerical vs lay moral 觉世真经. Narrower than 上清灵宝大法’s ocean of methods—selects what must be used, not all that can.

entries.logic_thesis: The great method proves that Shangqing vision and Lingbao universal salvation can be engineered as one ritual system: cosmology, registers, thunder/writing, and degree-person rites interlock so that private immortality and public salvation share machinery. Completeness of method is the argument—partial lineages are incomplete medicine for a multi-layered cosmos.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: world includes heavens, hells, stars, ancestors, and living bodies. 2) Inference: one technique class cannot address all layers. 3) Inference: integrated dafa assigns tools to layers. 4) Inference: master of dafa becomes cosmic functionary. 5) Conclusion: vastness is necessary, not decadent, for full soteriology.
entries.logic_practice: 1) BaZi: multi-palace problems need multi-tools (ethics + breath + rite + environment). 2) Don’t treat career clash like health clash. 3) Build personal “small dafa”: ranked responses by severity. 4) Study symbolism of registers as chart “files.” 5) Avoid method hoarding without virtue base.
entries.logic_compare: Maximalist versus 玉碑子 minimalism and 九要心印 condensation. More ritual-technical than 金丹大要’s interior alchemy. Synthesizes what 开演秘密藏经 theorizes as treasury.

entries.name_han: 太上说十炼生神救护经
entries.logic_thesis: The text proves that spirit-body gods are produced or restored through ten stages of refinement; rescue (救护) is metallurgy of the person. Salvation is not a single pardon but iterative tempering until protective deities within are viable. Disaster and early death signal incomplete refining of the spirit set.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: person hosts multiple spirits needing generation/completion. 2) Inference: stages of refining correspond to layers of vulnerability. 3) Inference: each completed stage adds protection and clarity. 4) Inference: rite and ascesis enact the tenfold sequence. 5) Conclusion: rescue = completed internal pantheon via disciplined process.
entries.logic_practice: 1) BaZi: count repeated damage to same element as failed “refine stage”—design ten-step remediation. 2) Pair decade luck with stage goals (essence, qi, spirit…). 3) After acute danger years, perform rebuilding regimen, not only relief. 4) Visualize organ-spirits in medical-Daoist hygiene. 5) Ethical refining (truthfulness, non-harm) as co-equal to breath stages.
entries.logic_compare: More sequential-soteriological than 胎息’s single method; more internalized than 南斗 external officers—yet compatible (inner gods ↔ outer offices). Differs from 清规 by focusing on spirit-generation rather than monastic law.

entries.logic_thesis: The scripture proves that cosmic justice is transparent and responsive: moral acts write directly into fortune, and “awakening the world” is exposing that ledger so people self-correct. Guandi as enforcer unites martial uprightness with retributive clarity—no esotericism excuses vice. Public ethics are the accessible face of Dao for ordinary destiny repair.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: heaven’s eye and spirit officers record deeds. 2) Inference: good/bad issue in measurable life outcomes. 3) Inference: preaching the ledger awakens fear and resolve. 4) Inference: repentance plus reform rewrites pending retribution. 5) Conclusion: social morality is practical theology of fate.
entries.logic_practice: 1) BaZi: when 七杀/羊刃 without virtue narrative, prescribe Guandi-style precepts first. 2) Audit speech, money, sex as three high-retribution channels. 3) Use oath and public accountability for 伤官 charts. 4) Charity timed to conflict years as counter-ledger. 5) Read sudden disasters as prompts to moral review, not only luck mechanics.
entries.logic_compare: Exoteric vs neidan secrecy; Chinese theistic retribution vs Laozi’s amoral cosmism. Complements 南斗 petition with ethical precondition. Less clerical-technical than 道门通教必用集; aimed at lay transformation.

entries.name_han: 太上无极大道自然真一五称符上经
entries.logic_thesis: The text proves that the “True One” of spontaneous Dao expresses as five appellation-talismans: cosmic functions are nameable seals that, when correctly held, reunify multiplicity into natural unity. Symbol and reality are not two—the fu is the operable face of Wuji’s true one. Practice is alignment with fivefold self-naming of the Dao rather than personal invention.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: Ultimate Non-Polar still issues patterned functions. 2) Inference: five titles/fu encode those functions. 3) Inference: holding/inscribing them tunes agent to natural True One. 4) Inference: disorder is misalignment with the fivefold seal. 5) Conclusion: talismanic practice is metaphysics made portable.
entries.logic_practice: 1) BaZi: five phases as five “appellations” of one Day Master life—restore missing phase as restoring a seal. 2) Draw or visualize phase-correct symbols in corresponding seasons. 3) Speech: five true names of intent (stillness, clarity, fairness, restraint, sincerity). 4) Correct environment colors/directions as fu-fields. 5) Avoid random talisman collecting; match to chart deficit.
entries.logic_compare: More abstract-cosmological than 关帝 moralism; more symbolic-operational than pure 指归 philosophy. Shares Lingbao love of writs but centers True One fivefold structure rather than full dafa bureaucracy.

entries.logic_thesis: The scripture proves that the entire elixir path compresses into nine essentials sealed in the heart-mind: transmission is mind-to-mind imprint (心印), not accumulation of texts. If the seal is true, few words suffice; if false, oceans of classics fail. Mastery is verified by interior certification, not external display.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: Dao’s method is simple at root. 2) Inference: proliferation hides the seal. 3) Inference: nine essentials structure the whole path. 4) Inference: heart receives imprint when vessel is still and ethical. 5) Conclusion: authentic lineage is recognition of the same seal, expressed as brief keys.
entries.logic_practice: 1) BaZi: extract nine maxims max from any chart—no encyclopedic dump. 2) Meditation: one mudra of intent (true seal) each session. 3) Test teachings: can they restate 金丹大要/大丹直指 in nine points without remainder? 4) In confused luck, return to essentials list. 5) Teacher choice: who impresses seal, not who performs complexity.
entries.logic_compare: Most compressed counterweight to 上清灵宝大法 and even 金丹大要. Aligns with 大丹直指’s “direct pointing” but framed as heart-seal mysticism. Differs from 功课经 by being non-liturgical interior certification.
